# GreenPoint Maintenance Services

> New York State-certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) providing commercial janitorial and facility cleaning services across New York City and the surrounding region — for government, commercial, healthcare, education, and religious facilities.

GreenPoint Maintenance Services Corp is a Bronx-based commercial cleaning and janitorial company. It is a New York State-certified MBE, an approved NYC Department of Education vendor, and a registered federal contractor (SAM.gov). Services span commercial and office cleaning, government and municipal janitorial contracts, school and NYC DOE cleaning, medical and behavioral-health facility cleaning, and house-of-worship cleaning, serving the five boroughs of New York City and nearby counties.

## Services
- [Janitorial Services NYC](https://www.greenpointms.com/janitorial-services-nyc/): Commercial janitorial and cleaning services across New York City.
- [Commercial Cleaning Bronx](https://www.greenpointms.com/commercial-cleaning-bronx/): Office and commercial cleaning in the Bronx.
- [Government Cleaning Services](https://www.greenpointms.com/government-cleaning-services/): Janitorial services for government and municipal contracts.
- [School Cleaning NYC](https://www.greenpointms.com/school-cleaning-nyc/): Cleaning services for schools.
- [NYC DOE School Cleaning](https://www.greenpointms.com/nyc-doe-school-cleaning/): Approved NYC Department of Education cleaning vendor.
- [Church & House of Worship Cleaning](https://www.greenpointms.com/church-cleaning-nyc/): Cleaning for churches and religious facilities.
- [All Services](https://www.greenpointms.com/services/): Full list of cleaning and janitorial services.
